subject: maths
question:
Study the given bar graph and answer the question that follows.

The following bar graph shows the number of deaths that happened in cities 1, 2, 3 and 4 in the month mentioned.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d45251b1c6511c75618ba54026e0bd7a28fab1d939ae509acc6999ce7050858c.png] 

The average number of deaths that occurred during April across all the cities (rounded off to the next integer) is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average number of deaths that occurred during April across all the cities

⇒ (860 + 765 + 960 + 1148)/4

⇒ 933.25 nearly 934

**∴ The average number of deaths that occurred during April across all the cities approx 934.**
